propositions: The _is_at_level target-side guard in _same_level_neighbors is not exercised by existing single-level tests and must not be deleted without test coverage for direct cross-level edges whose far end is the queried source_id

A _load_states_with_tombstones branch that returns a status-only stub when reduce returns None and a tombstone is present is only observable when the recorded tombstone status is non-terminal (e.g. open)
A tombstone's status must override the reduced status in _load_states_with_tombstones so that a terminal tombstone status (e.g. deleted) causes the blocker to be treated as closed
Malformed or unparseable tombstone bytes must degrade to deleted rather than to absent to maintain consistent behavior in _read_tombstone_status
An epic→task→epic traversal chain must not reconnect same-level nodes even with cross-level edges present
The loader/BFS refactor elevated previously inline behaviors into named helpers, exposing pre-existing test gaps that must be pinned by characterization tests to prevent silent regressions
